prompt: In 2025, how much time did Americans (age 15+) spend on these leisure activities on an average day? Rank them from most time to least.

items.label: Playing games and computer use for leisure

explanation: TV still takes about half of all leisure time: 2.6 of 5.2 leisure hours a day in 2025. Games and leisure computer use average 37 minutes, exercise about 20 minutes and reading about 16.

source.title: American Time Use Survey — 2025 Results, Table 11A: Time spent in leisure and sports activities

extraSources.title: American Time Use Survey Summary — 2025 Results

caveat: Averages cover everyone age 15+, including people who did not do the activity that day; primary activity only. ATUS collection was suspended Oct 1–Nov 12, 2025 (government shutdown), which BLS says may have affected 2025 estimates.

prompt: In 2026, what percentage of U.S. adults said they ever drink alcoholic beverages (rather than being total abstainers)?
explanation: 54% in July 2026, tied with 2025 for the lowest reading in Gallup's trend going back to 1939. It was 62% in 2023 and 58% in 2024.

source.title: Americans' Drinking Remains at Record Low

caveat: Self-reported; telephone survey of 1,200 adults, July 1–19, 2026.

prompt: In 2023 (Gallup's latest reading), what share of U.S. adults said they are vegetarian?
explanation: 4% of U.S. adults identify as vegetarian, and 1% as vegan. Gallup found about the same in 2012 and 2018, and 6% in 1999 and 2001.

source.title: In U.S., 4% Identify as Vegetarian, 1% as Vegan

caveat: Self-identification, July 3–27, 2023; Gallup's most recent reading.

prompt: In October 2026, what percentage of U.S. adults said there is a gun in their household?
explanation: 43% report a gun in their household: 31% personally own one and 12% say another household member does. The figure has been steady; the average since 2000 is also 43%.

source.title: Majorities Favor Stricter Gun Laws, Assault Rifle Ban

caveat: Self-reported, Oct 1–19, 2026. Share of adults, not of households.

prompt: As of 2023 (latest Census data), what share of Americans ages 25 to 34 lived in a parent's home?
explanation: 18% of 25- to 34-year-olds lived in a parent's home in 2023 (20% of young men, 15% of young women). The share rose from 2000 to 2017 and has slipped a little since.

source.title: The shares of young adults living with parents vary widely across the U.S.

caveat: Pew analysis of Census Bureau American Community Survey data. The age range matters: figures that include 18- to 24-year-olds are much higher.

prompt: In 2024, what share of U.S. adults got less than 7 hours of sleep in a typical 24-hour period?
explanation: 30.5% of adults averaged under 7 hours of sleep in 2024. In the same survey, 54.8% said they woke up feeling well-rested most days or every day.

source.publisher: CDC National Center for Health Statistics
source.title: Short Sleep Duration and Sleep Difficulties Among Adults: United States, 2024 (NCHS Data Brief No. 559)

caveat: Self-reported average sleep from the National Health Interview Survey; 7 hours is the recommended minimum for adults.

prompt: In 2023, what percentage of U.S. adults said they had never traveled outside the United States?
explanation: 23% have never traveled internationally. About half have been to one to four other countries, and 26% have been to five or more.

source.title: Americans who have traveled internationally stand out in their views and knowledge of foreign affairs

caveat: Self-reported, from Pew's March 2023 American Trends Panel survey; the most recent Pew reading found.
